customer_name: Yalong River Hydropower Development Co., Ltd. (雅砻江流域水电开发有限公司)
business_problem: Yalong River Hydropower Development managed dispersed hydrological, weather, generation, equipment, maintenance, demand, and market-price data across a large hydropower and renewable-energy portfolio. Manual reporting and coordination could not support whole-basin optimization as planned capacity expanded.
solution_summary: Yalong River Hydropower Development built an integrated intelligent-operations architecture on Huawei Cloud Stack, combining an industry large model with openJiuwen Commercial Edition agents. A central decision agent coordinates forecasting, power dispatch, production operations, and marketing agents, bringing together weather, water, equipment, and market information. Huawei Cloud data and model engineering support regional forecasting models trained on basin observations, while model outputs feed hydropower, wind, and solar forecasts and dispatch planning. Agents also support equipment fault diagnosis, maintenance recommendations, work-ticket generation, and energy trading workflows. Huawei Cloud Stack supplies the computing foundation for extensive device data and continuous operations. The source describes operational integration but does not name specific storage products or external systems.

solution_components.name: Huawei Cloud Stack
solution_components.role: Provides the cloud foundation and stable compute capacity for the basin-wide intelligent operations and device-data workloads.

solution_components.name: Huawei Cloud industry large model
solution_components.role: Supports regional water, wind, and solar forecasting and AI-assisted operational analysis.

solution_components.name: openJiuwen Commercial Edition
solution_components.role: Coordinates the central decision agent and specialist forecasting, dispatch, production, and marketing agents.

data_flow: Basin observation, weather, hydrological, equipment, generation, and market data are aggregated for the central decision agent; forecasting and operational agents produce forecasts and recommendations that inform dispatch, maintenance, and trading workflows.
business_outcome: The company extended medium- and long-term runoff forecasting, shortened generation planning, improved operations and equipment maintenance, and established coordinated renewable-energy trading workflows.
metrics: Runoff forecast horizon extended from 45 days to 60 days
Water, wind, and solar resource utilization increased by more than 1%
Generation plans generated in under 3 minutes
Load allocation response time controlled within 30 seconds
AI diagnosis accuracy for photovoltaic modules reached more than 96%
Work-ticket preparation time reduced from 30 minutes to 5 minutes
Work-ticket accuracy improved to more than 98%
architecture_clues: Architecture uses one central coordinating agent and four specialist agent domains
Data coverage includes 38 hydropower units, more than 200 wind turbines, over 10,000 inverters, and millions of photovoltaic modules
Cloud platform supports continuous operation of the trading application

source_references.title: When AI meets rivers: Yalong River integrated hydro-wind-solar intelligent operations

evidence_quotes: The system connects hydrology, meteorology, runoff, and power forecasting across the full chain (original: 大模型贯通“气象—降雨—径流—功率”全链路).
The generation plan is generated within three minutes (original: 发电计划生成时间缩短至3分钟以内).
